name: resume-after-reset-mvp
description: Resume work in the same chat after your usage limit resets, with an optional account usage meter.

interface.shortDescription: Continue chats after a usage reset
interface.longDescription: Automatically send your saved continuation instruction into the same chat after the next usage reset. A local macOS service handles the schedule and delivery. An optional account usage meter shows your available allowance.
defaultPrompt: Enable continuation after the next usage reset in this chat.
When is this chat scheduled to resume?
